description.p: ArrowEscape is a relaxing arrow puzzle game for Linux. Every board is a tightly packed tangle of arrows: click an arrow to slide it off the board in the direction it points, but only when its path to the edge is clear. Find the right order, untangle the maze and clear the board. A calm logic puzzle and brain teaser with simple rules, deep strategy and no timer.

ul.li: Endless levels, generated so every board always has a solution
Difficulty that climbs from gentle Easy boards to huge, densely tangled Master boards
Three lives per board, hints when you are stuck and a one-click restart
Hover an arrow to highlight it before you click
Boards shaped like pictures: shapes, animals, nature, objects and letters
A collection that fills in as you solve each picture
Zoom with the mouse wheel or touchpad, drag to pan, and fit the board to the window
Works with a mouse or a touchscreen, including pinch to zoom
Light and dark themes, a soft piano soundtrack and slide-off sound effects you can turn off
Progress and settings are saved automatically; play offline

description.p: Free to play with endless levels and the Shapes pack. An optional one-time Pro upgrade, with a 5-day free trial, adds the Animals, Nature, Objects and Letters picture packs, colourful arrows and unlimited hints. No ads and no subscription.

A calm alternative to mobile arrow puzzle games, for anyone who likes logic puzzles, brain teasers and relaxing casual games. Works on Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE and other Linux distributions, on Wayland and X11.

description.p: Boards are dramatically more tangled: arrows are longer and wind deeper, and the difficulty ramps up fast: a dense labyrinth by level 13 instead of hundreds of easy levels.

Mouse navigation is fixed and expanded: smooth wheel zoom (including touchpads and hi-res wheels), drag to pan from anywhere on the board, plus on-screen zoom, fit and straighten controls. Hovering an arrow now highlights it so you always know which one you are about to tap.
Also fixes duplicated background music after minimising and improves button legibility.
Hundreds of fully-packed arrow-untangling puzzles with a difficulty ramp from Easy to Master, a soft piano soundtrack, light and dark themes, a zoomable board and saved progress.
